verdict.rationale: Airweave's own sync pipeline ingests documents and attachments from connected sources, such as Airtable attachments and Bitbucket code files, and makes them searchable later, so stored files can be recalled. However, the evidence never shows direct upload of files as memory inputs, and never mentions images or PDF parsing. Missing for 10: direct file/image/PDF upload as memory inputs, documented PDF and image content extraction, independent hands-on corroboration of recall from file contents.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store images, PDFs, or other files as memory inputs and recall information from them later

citations.quote: Airweave connects to your apps, databases, and documents, then turns them into knowledge you can search.
Airtable source connector — syncs bases, tables, records, comments, attachments.
It supports syncing workspaces, repositories, directories, and code files with configurable filtering options for branches and file types.
It searches with multiple strategies, reads full documents, navigates entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling), and builds a comprehensive result set.
